scene: The automaton chimes, powering three grand transit lines across the bustling pier.
picture: A flat side view along the wooden pier platform. At centre, the broad-shouldered Pacific Islander man in a floral shirt and ukulele smiles beside the whirring brass automaton. On the far left waits a sleek pink bullet train with open doors; on the right, a serpentine green maglev; up high, a cable pod hangs from overhead wires.
shown: a sleek pink bullet train with open pneumatic doors on the far left
a long green maglev dragon train waiting patiently at the right platform
a spherical glass cloud cable pod swaying gently up high above centre
